title: A Data-Driven Closed-Loop Control Approach to Drive Neural State Transitions for Mechanistic Insight.

reviewer_b_anchors: Methods 'Data', 'Dynamical system reconstruction', and 'Control framework'; Results figures report power-spectrum Hellinger distance, functional-connectivity agreement, 80-step controlled trajectories, target proximity, control energy, and 11 region-restricted controls; Data Availability identifies humml-lab/fmri-control.
adjudication_anchors: Human Brain Mapping PMCID PMC13370802: Methods 5.2-5.3 (DSR and control), Results Figs. 2-6, Supplementary Figs. S4 and S12, Limitations, and Data Availability; official humml-lab/fmri-control repository.
adjudication_notes: Free controlled trajectories are evaluated over time, with D=5 versus D=10 horizon sensitivity, zero-control and 11 region-restricted perturbations. title: A digital twin for hospital antimicrobial resistance forecasting and constrained intervention optimisation
reviewer_a_anchors: medRxiv v1 Methods: synthetic hospital, H=7 graph forecasting, matched policy branches and MILP; Results report stress tests, held-out action-ranking accuracy/regret/non-worsening; official predictive and causal GitHub repositories.
reviewer_b_anchors: Preprint Methods define the synthetic 10-ward/200-patient/300-staff hospital, T=7/H=7 prediction, partial surveillance, five-policy branch, common deterministic noise, and constrained optimization; Results report surveillance and distribution-shift stress tests and policy ranking; equation defines ΔB7(a)=B7(baseline)-B7(a).
adjudication_anchors: medRxiv version 1 full text: Methods on the synthetic hospital, T=7/H=7 temporal graph task, partial observation, common-state/common-noise intervention branching, and constrained MILP; Results on surveillance and distribution shifts and within-state policy ranking; Code Availability links the predictive and causal repositories.
adjudication_notes: The explicit seven-day burden contrast, predefined policy strategies, common-state/common-noise branching, full simulator support, and matched synthetic counterfactual outcomes satisfy causal level 2 within the stated simulator. Synthetic shifts support external level 1 but are not frozen real-hospital validation. The learned forecaster is fixed H=7, while non-worsening and optimization constraints constitute an explicit simulated hazard/constraint test.

title: DITTO: A Visual Digital Twin for Interventions and Temporal Treatment Outcomes in Head and Neck Cancer.
reviewer_a_anchors: arXiv:2407.13107 pp. 3-4 and Appendix pp. 12-16 describe the cohort, 389/147 split, three treatment stages, transition and survival metrics, MC-dropout intervals and limitations; Figs. 5-8 and clinician case studies evaluate the interface.
reviewer_b_anchors: Accepted manuscript Sections 3-5, quantitative evaluation tables, DITTO workflow/interface figures, two case studies, and Appendix A.2; temporal outputs are shown at 12/24/36/48 months and to 5 years; MC dropout uses at least 20 samples; propensity matching requires at least 5 comparators within a caliper; formative work involved 11 physicians.
adjudication_anchors: Accepted author manuscript arXiv:2407.13107, Sections 3-5, Figs. 5-8, quantitative tables, and Appendix A.2. Main text reports n=526, while Appendix A.2 reports n=536=389+147; both values are retained as an unresolved publication inconsistency.
adjudication_notes: Stage-specific transition/outcome components are directly evaluated and clinician-centered participatory/case-study evidence supports decision level 2. Untreated/treated propensity-matched comparators and alternative treatment-sequence changes satisfy the descriptive action comparator and perturbation features, without establishing causal identification.

title: Digital twin brain simulator for real-time consciousness monitoring and virtual intervention using primate electrocorticogram data
reviewer_a_anchors: PMC11811282 Methods: leave-one-animal-out ECoG training, online data assimilation and z1/z2/z3 virtual interventions; Figs. 2-5 and Table 1 report prediction, latent organization and intervention classification; public h-idei/pvrnn_sa code.
reviewer_b_anchors: Methods describe 4 macaques, 20 ECoG channels/10 regions, hierarchical z1/z2/z3 V-RNN, four-fold held-out-animal evaluation, rolling-500-observation/100-update assimilation, and virtual intervention; Results and supplement report power spectra, connectivity, latent clusters, 1-100-step prediction error, and 2,000-step virtual intervention.
adjudication_anchors: npj Digital Medicine PMCID PMC11811282: Methods on ECoG data, hierarchical V-RNN, data assimilation, and virtual intervention; Figs. 2-5, Table 1, supplementary 1-100-step prediction results, and 2,000-step intervention; Data Availability; h-idei/pvrnn_sa repository checked.
adjudication_notes: The paper reports free-running errors across 1-100 steps, intervention versus non-intervention and multi-level latent perturbations, and leave-one-animal transfer followed by adaptation. Thus rollout/action are level 2, external and decision evidence are level 1, frozen external validation is no, and the generic public PV-RNN implementation yields partial rather than complete reproducibility.

title: Koopman-based linearization of preparatory EEG dynamics in Parkinson's disease during galvanic vestibular stimulation.
reviewer_a_anchors: PMC12116581 Methods: subject-level six-fold CV, Deep Koopman and LQR; Fig. 4 reports NMSE through 15 prediction steps; Fig. 8 compares controlled and uncontrolled latent trajectories; official DeepKoopman_PD repository includes code and sample data.
reviewer_b_anchors: Methods report 18 PD and 18 control participants, subject-level six-fold splits, three-dimensional Koopman state, 1-15-step m-step prediction, and LQR; Results report horizon-specific NMSE, observed sham/GVS1/GVS2 and medication contrasts, spatial maps, motor correlations, and controlled-versus-uncontrolled LQR trajectories; Code Availability reports a public repository.
adjudication_anchors: Frontiers full text PMCID PMC12116581: participants and EEG preprocessing, six-fold subject split, Deep Koopman model, 1-15-step prediction (Fig. 4), LQR methods and controlled/uncontrolled trajectory with bounded inputs (Fig. 8), statistics, and Data/Code Availability.
adjudication_notes: Observed GVS comparisons and restoration language provide partial causal evidence, but no explicit treatment-effect estimand is defined. Bounded/stable LQR inputs are a constraint proxy (safety level 1), not a clinical hazard test.

title: Modelling neural coding in the auditory midbrain with high resolution and accuracy.
reviewer_a_anchors: PMC12460167 Results Figs. 1-5 and Methods: unseen sounds, held-out animals, response-distribution metrics and neurophysiology tests; Data/Code Availability; official ICNet repository provides pretrained weights and executable notebook.
reviewer_b_anchors: Methods describe 14 gerbils, high-resolution sound/MUA alignment, 64-dimensional bottleneck, categorical 0-4 event-count decoder, held-out sounds, random 10% validation, leave-one-animal encoder freezing with decoder adaptation, and bootstrap=1,000; Results evaluate RMSE, likelihood, Fano factor, explainable variance, forward masking, and adaptation; official ICNet repository includes code, config, examples, and DNN/model_weights.hdf5.
adjudication_anchors: Nature Machine Intelligence PMCID PMC12460167: Methods on animals, sounds, architecture, held-out sounds, transfer, and statistics; Results Figs. 1-5 on likelihood/RMSE, Fano factor, explainable variance, speech, forward masking, and adaptation; Data/Code Availability and official ICNet repository with pretrained weights.
adjudication_notes: ICNet directly predicts time-resolved responses under complete exogenous sound input but is a feed-forward temporal convolution rather than a recursive state transition, so dynamics evidence is level 1.
